faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the OAV Garudabasa Warden recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the OAV Garudabasa Warden recruitment is 11th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Warden post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.A. or B.Sc. degree from a recognized university and have at least two years of experience in hostel management to be eligible for the Warden position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the OAV Garudabasa Warden recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Warden post is between 30 years and 60 years. However, retired teachers meeting specific criteria may be considered up to 62 years.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Warden post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Warden post will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 25,621.75.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Warden post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the post of Warden at Odisha Adarsha Vidyalaya Garudabasa.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to send their filled application forms to the official address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type for the Warden position is contractual.

faq.answer: OAV Garudabasa is located in Betnoti, Odisha, with the pincode 757100.
